links.comparator_used: Initial unguided classification (single prompt, no feedback) versus feedback-informed reclassification after feedback on 20% of misclassified cases
links.outcome: Accuracy of classifying medications as antimicrobial vs non-antimicrobial (7,239 entries, against manual reference standard)
links.effect: All accuracies improved significantly (P < .001) postfeedback: Gemini 99.6%, Claude Sonnet 4 99.4%, ChatGPT-3.5 81.0%, Copilot 79.7%; Gemini had the highest error reduction rate (69.2%) and macro-F1 of 98.9% (95% CI: 98.4-99.3). Baseline accuracy values were not reported in the text.
links.quote: Postfeedback, all accuracies improved significantly (P < .001) to Gemini (99.6%), Claude Sonnet 4 (99.4%), ChatGPT-3.5 (81.0%), and Copilot (79.7%).
